title: 99 nights [free]
features:
Key is free in dc, no workink or shi

Teleport to locations: Campsite and Safe Zone

Item ESP: Highlights supported items with labels

Teleport to items: Jump to selected item types

Bring items: Moves matching items to your position

Bulk item teleport: Supports many item types, including logs, weapons, ammunition, medical supplies and blueprints

Bring mobs: Teleports selected NPCs to your position

Player Enhancements
WalkSpeed

Adjustable slider up to 700, plus a toggle for speed 50.

JumpPower

Adjustable slider up to 700.

Safe Zone

Creates nine large invisible baseplates that can be made visible and collidable through a toggle.

Visuals
Player ESP: Displays other players' names and health percentages.

Chams: Highlights player body parts through objects.

FOV Circle: Displays a circle around the mouse position.

Item ESP: Shows labels above supported items.

Miscellaneous
Infinite Yield: Loads the external Infinite Yield utility.

Emote GUI: Loads an external animation script.

Anti-AFK: Attempts to prevent idle disconnections.

Multiple tabs: Main, Auto, Item TP/ESP, Game TP, Mob TP, Player, Visuals and Misc.
